title: Project Deployment Completed Event
description: A built artifact of one pjangler project was installed on a target (a phone, a host service or a site) and the deploy script's own post-checks passed. data.summary is the one line a notification shows. ordering_key is project:<slug>. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (project).
$comment: Hygiene inherited from the project domain: no credentials, no stderr dumps, no absolute filesystem paths in data. The artifact path stays on the build host; data.artifact.sha256 identifies the bytes.

ordering_key.description: §11.1 bucket project:<project_slug>, the same value as 'project:' + data.project.slug.

summary.description: One human line, e.g. 'Gruvato v0.2.3 (2003) dd0e4c8 installed on SM-S948U, checksum verified'.

deliveries.description: Optional: one entry per device when a deploy covers several (target.kind device-set).

verified.description: True when the deploy script's post-check passed: an installed-APK checksum match, or a service health check.

kind.description: mobile-app is one app version delivered to several devices at once (data.deliveries); its sha256 is null.

name.description: What was deployed, e.g. the app, site or service name.

version_code.description: Platform build number when the platform has one (Android versionCode).

commit.description: Commit the artifact was built from.

dirty.description: True when the build tree had uncommitted tracked changes.

variant.description: Build variant, e.g. debug or release.

sha256.description: Digest of the deployed artifact file, when the deploy has a single file.

kind.description: device-set names several devices in one deploy, e.g. 'SM-S948U + iPad14,5'; data.deliveries holds one entry per device.

name.description: Device model, simulator and its host, host name or site origin.

id.description: Stable target identifier when one exists, e.g. the device serial.

delivery.description: One device install inside a multi-device deploy (mobile-deploy-hub: the S26 and the iPad). verified means the device read back the planned version (and, for Android, the installed base.apk sha256).

target.description: Device model, e.g. SM-S948U or iPad14,5.

build.description: Android versionCode or iOS CFBundleVersion, as a string.

sha256.description: Digest of the installed file (APK or IPA), when known.

stage.description: Where this delivery stopped, when it failed.

reason.description: One short line, when it failed. No paths, no stderr dumps.

run.description: The CI run that made the deploy (mobile-deploy-hub: the app repo's Actions run). Reruns keep id and raise attempt.

hub_ref.description: The mobile-deploy-hub ref the run used (a tag after the pin).
